newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices mixed after French poll.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices mixed after French poll.

text.p: Danish bond prices opened mixed on Monday, but dealers said that greater than expected support for the left in the first round of French elections had dampened sentiment, reviving fears about the fate of EMU.

At 0700 GMT the benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 was down 0.50 point from Friday's close, at 109.90, yielding 6.48 percent. But the forthcoming benchmark seven percent state bond due 2007 rose 0.08 point, to 102.90 yielding 6.59 percent.
The yield gap between the 2006 bond and the German bund widened four basis points to 56 bp and the 2007-bund gap narrowed by five basis points to 67 bp.
